answer_4.quote: ... we invite annotators to manually annotate interpretability scores for all possible rules to establish a manually-annotated benchmark (A-benchmark). ... we ask ten annotators to annotate and take their average score as the final result. ... we let the annotator choose one of the following three options, namely reasonable, partially reasonable, and unreasonable ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators select one of three options for each path: reasonable, partially reasonable, or unreasonable.
